title: Metronome
description: The first time you [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]7[/blue] [gold]Orbs[/gold] each combat, deal [blue]30[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks orbs channeled during combat and deals damage when the threshold (7 orbs) is reached. Displays a counter showing current orbs channeled. Becomes highlighted (Active status) when one orb away from triggering. Counter and trigger reset at the end of each combat.
